suggested_fix.fix_text: The agents have repeatedly failed to find the answer on the Busba Kitiyakara Wikipedia page by loading the same viewport (61% down) where information is visible but not scrolled into view. probe_details.notes: The proposed error analysis is incorrect on multiple fronts. 1) Turn 14 contains a severe logic hallucination, claiming 'No prior result exists in this session' despite 13 previous turns occurring in the same conversation history. 2) The claim that agents searched 'exact same terms' is false; they used 'Busba Kitiyakara paternal grandfather', 'Busba Kitiyakara Wikipedia', and the direct URL. 3) The root cause is not a lack of search variation, but a failure to utilize the WebSurfer tool's scrolling capability or to click into search results to read content beyond the initial snippet/viewport. The agent found the correct name (Prince Kitiyakara Voralaksa) in Turn 12 via reasoning but failed to verify it on the source page because it was staring at the same static viewport repeatedly. A prompt hint about scrolling or examining specific sections would have resolved the issue.
